question: Was an accessible, current, precision-described and appropriately reusable official boundary-vector product established for the exact three subjects?

products.product_candidate: National Fundamental Geographic Information Database public 1:250,000 edition; catalogue describes county polygon layer
products.publisher: National Fundamental Geographic Information Center (NGCC), Ministry of Natural Resources
products.native_vector_boundary: catalogue search result describes polygon layer, but no exact downloadable archive or full product metadata was retrieved
products.vintage: unresolved; catalogue index includes records whose data currentness is described as 2012; separate 2020 platform announcement documents updates to selected 1:250,000 public base layers but does not establish this county-boundary layer's vintage
products.scale_or_precision: nominal 1:250,000 for candidate public data; no product-specific positional accuracy or boundary-maintenance statement verified
products.access: National catalogue lead at https://www.webmap.cn/main.do?method=index1; direct page retrieval timed out in this assessment; product-specific archive route not verified
products.redistribution_terms: unknown for underlying vector data; catalogue website carries all-rights-reserved/no unauthorized copy-or-mirror wording, which cannot be safely generalized into a definitive raw-product license
products.decision: lead only; not usable as a verified reusable source or geometry comparison in this child
missing: complete vector archive and file-member inventory
product-specific permission for retaining/redistributing original bytes

products.publisher: National Platform for Common Geospatial Information Services
products.native_vector_boundary: no; documented response provides administrative identifiers/levels and spatial search results such as bounds/center, not a boundary-vector archive
products.vintage: service documentation accessed 2026-10-06; data-vintage metadata not established
products.scale_or_precision: not specified for downloadable county boundary vectors because none were documented
products.access: service/API documentation https://lbs.tianditu.gov.cn/server/search2.html; key required for service use
products.redistribution_terms: unknown for raw geometry; online service access does not grant feature redistribution rights

products.native_vector_boundary: not established; published description concerns parcel/property boundary lookup and identifying which administrative place contains an object; no district vector download located
products.access: https://geoportal.tj/; no downloadable administrative boundary product was identified

products.product_candidate: Official administrative area unit statistics workbook
products.publisher: Agency on Statistics under the President of Tajikistan
products.native_vector_boundary: no; counts at national/region level only
products.access: retained official XLSX download, 11,242 encoded bytes and 28,161 decoded ZIP member bytes
products.redistribution_terms: CC BY 4.0 per publisher's analytical-tables page, with source link attribution
products.decision: supports counts only; no boundary comparison

scope_limits: No PDF, raster, tile set or vector boundary was downloaded.
No source-versus-Atlas or cross-border geometry overlay was repeated.
Administrative polygons, if later obtained, would be reference geometry only; they do not establish an international boundary, historical title, physical land/water, or territorial assignment.
The result is that a qualifying product was not established in this bounded assessment, not proof that no product exists.
